artworks.label: New Year's Day
artworks.prompt:
Create ONE finished original artwork for Emviary, a quiet curated Colorado nature-art frame. Wide landscape canvas, aspect ratio about 5:3, intended for an 800x480 six-color e-paper panel with a 752x326 or 752x364 artwork area. It must be a complete illustration, not a contact sheet, device mockup, icon, crest, badge, logo or greeting card. No birds, other animals, people, lettering, words, numbers, watermark, border or frame. Visually substantial composition: main subject fills roughly 80-85 percent of the useful canvas, balanced around the center, all important subjects safely inside a small 5 percent margin. Limited dominant palette: clean near-white, charcoal, ochre/yellow, restrained red, blue and deep green. Orange is a restrained red/yellow mixture. Strong separation of light and dark shapes, clear recognizable silhouettes, broad areas of color and modest natural depth. Avoid faint washes, fine stippling, grainy paper, artificial aging, brown sepia background, gray haze, busy patterns, neon, purple, tiny details and continuous smooth gradients. Render artwork only; Emviary adds crisp greetings and weather separately.
Occasion: New Year's Day.
Style: Refined vintage landscape-poster painting with a restrained gouache finish: broad thoughtfully composed scenic layers, clear foreground/middle/distant planes, strong tonal hierarchy, quiet museum-shop print sensibility. Painted rather than generic flat vector clip art; texture extremely restrained and no dense foliage microdetail.
Subject: A hopeful Colorado winter morning, broad golden sunrise behind blue mountain silhouettes, dark-green pine grove and clean white snowbanks. A quiet new beginning, no sunburst emblem.
